product_metadata.title: Allrange 300TC Cool Tencel Clean&Safe Quilted Mattress Pad, Stretch-up-to 22", Fitted Tencel Polyester Fill, Silky Cotton Tencel Cover,Oeko-TEX Certified, Full
features: 【COOL TENCEL MATTRESS PAD】This Tencel mattress pad provides night sweaters a more breathable, absorbent, cooling and refreshing sleep. Made of Tencel fabric and 300-thread-count cotton, this mattress protector is hypoallergenic and feels super soft and comfortable. Patented skirt up-to 22” deep gives your bed a perfect snug-fit. Waving quilting allows you to sleep in any position with its shape remaining unchanged and quiet.Easy care with machine washing.PRODUCT DIMENSION ( L X W ):54"X75"+16"

【SILKY COTTON & BREATHABLE COMFORT】300-thread-count COTTON fabric makes this mattress pad durable, fine and smooth, silky and comfortable. TENCEL, an environment friendly and sustainable fiber carrying OEKO-TEX 100 certification, has unique moisture control capabilities to ABSORB MOISTURE into the fabric and REGULATE TEMPERATURE built up materialized by moisture wicking technology, giving you a breathable sleep at night, COOL in summer and WARM in winter.

【PATENTED PERFECT FIT & WAVY QUILTING】The patented 4-way stretch skirt enables 16” skirt to fit mattress deep to 22” with a perfect snug fit. Wavy stitch quilting pattern prevents the polyester filling from clumping and shifting, and enables the filling to be evenly spread. Simple but timeless styled pattern matches your home décor easily

【CLEAN&SAFE】Under high standard manufacturing processes and high quality materials honestly listed above, especially the most natural and nontoxic fiber-Tencel, our mattress pad is made truly clean and safe, keeping you a safe and sound sleep, say goodbye to runny nose.

【MACHINE WASHABLE & EASY CARE】Nothing particular, but recommend using front load commercial washer and dryer. Gentle or delicate setting, cold water, mild or all-natural detergent is preferred. Easy care and easy maintenance.NOTES: a warm or thick sheet (on top of mattress pad) would counteract its temperature regulating function, so we recommend to use this mattress pad with thin or cooling sheet.
